title: Area-code org enumeration shard A pass 23

data.research_question: Which current public anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid, collective and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable in shard-A NPAs 681, 684, 702 and 708?
data.method: Deterministic NPA shard-A enumeration using current NANPA authority, literal area-code and organization-family queries, locality-derived searches, current-status verification, repository dedupe, historical-lead checks, first-party/public-directory corroboration, and public organizational communications enumeration.
classification_rules: Use current in-service U.S. NANP geographic NPAs where integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.
Include NPA 684 because NANPA identifies American Samoa as a U.S. territory participating in the NANP.
Historical directories, old event pages and archive references are discovery seeds and do not establish current activity without fresh corroboration.
Area-code relations represent locality/discovery geography and do not assert telephone-number ownership unless a first-party organizational source publishes that NPA itself.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; do not merge organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
No private membership inference or person-level political/ideological affiliation profiling.

unresolved_leads: Ohio Valley Mutual Aid and the West Virginia People's Flood Relief Fund surfaced in recent flood-response reporting but require separate organizational identity/current-status resolution before promotion.
Pago Pago, Tutuila and American Samoa searches did not mature a current anarchist, Food Not Bombs, autonomous collective or grassroots mutual-aid organization in this bounded pass.
Las Vegas A-Cafe and Sunset Activist Collective remain historical-only leads requiring fresh organizational continuity evidence before any active classification.
Oak Park Mutual Aid has current 2026 public activity evidence but its canonical first-party organizational identity and communication surfaces require a separate resolution pass.
South Loop and other south-suburban mutual-aid names in older Chicago directories remain unresolved absent current-status corroboration.
